observations: Handwritten signature 'Meyer K.' on the 'Odebrał' (received by) line; no receiving date or stamp is shown.
Product description is cut off at '(96 p, hard' (closing text missing in the printed line).
Quantity '10.100' uses the Polish thousands separator, read as 10,100 pieces.
Quantity is printed, not handwritten; no strike-throughs or overwrites.
Gross weight 420 kg for 10,100 hardcover art books (about 42 g each) looks low. This is only a plausibility observation; the values are recorded as written.
